title: Exam Countdown & Study Planner
description:
Every exam has a date. This app turns that date into a plan.

Exam Countdown & Study Planner is the study planner and syllabus tracker for students who are tired of guessing what to study today. Add your exams, add your syllabus, and get a day-by-day study schedule that fits the time you actually have left.

⏳ EXAM COUNTDOWN FOR EVERY TEST
Add every quiz, midterm and final. See the exact days, hours and minutes left on each one, color-coded by urgency. Pin a live countdown to your home screen so exam day never sneaks up on you.

📚 SYLLABUS TRACKER
Break each course into chapters and topics, mark them not started, in progress or done, and watch a real completion percentage climb for every subject. The syllabus tracker shows what you have covered and, more usefully, what you have not.

🗓️ A STUDY PLANNER THAT BUILDS YOUR SCHEDULE (Premium)
Tell the planner which days you can study and for how long. It spreads your whole syllabus across the calendar up to exam day, then schedules spaced repetition reviews 1, 7 and 21 days after you first learn a topic. If the plan cannot fit in the time left, it warns you up front instead of quietly falling behind.

⏱️ POMODORO STUDY TIMER
A focus timer built for deep work: 25 or 50 minute Pomodoro sessions, a custom goal, or an open stopwatch. Immersive Zen, Rain and Forest themes plus an OLED dark mode keep you in the zone, and every minute logs straight to the chapter you studied.

✅ HOMEWORK & ASSIGNMENT TRACKER
A to-do list that speaks student. Tag tasks by subject and priority, set reminders for homework, assignments, lab reports and projects, and clear them before the deadline.

🔥 STUDY STREAKS & ANALYTICS
Daily study streaks, hours by subject, your most productive hours and week-by-week progress charts. Proof that the work is adding up.

📝 NOTES & REVISION ROUNDS
Keep formulas, definitions and worked problems next to the chapter they belong to, and track how many revision rounds each topic has had.

📱 HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Countdown, streak and subject progress widgets for your Android home screen.

🤖 MEET DIYA, YOUR AI STUDY PLANNER (Premium)
Diya is an AI study assistant that already knows your syllabus, your exam dates and your study history. Ask her to plan your week, explain a tough topic, rebuild your plan after a bad week, or quiz you with flashcards generated from your own chapters. Upload past papers and the question predictor ranks the chapters most likely to come up.

☁️ CLOUD SYNC ACROSS DEVICES (Premium)
Phone, tablet and Windows PC, always in sync, with backup and restore included, so a lost phone never means a lost plan.

🎯 BUILT FOR
High school, college and university students. Midterms and finals, AP, SAT and ACT prep, GRE, GMAT, LSAT and MCAT, nursing and bar exams, professional certifications, and any competitive exam with a syllabus and a deadline.

✨ FREE, AND WHAT PREMIUM ADDS
Free with no ads: unlimited exam countdowns, the syllabus tracker, the Pomodoro study timer, to-dos, notes, revision rounds, streaks, analytics and home screen widgets. Premium unlocks AI-built study plans, Diya, cloud sync and the past paper question predictor.

🔒 PRIVACY FIRST
Everything works offline and your study data stays on your device. Cloud sync is optional and only runs when you choose to sign in.

Available in 10 languages on Android, iOS and Windows.

Stop counting days. Start planning them. Download Exam Countdown & Study Planner and walk into your next exam knowing exactly what you have covered.

title: Student Trove - Study Planner
description:
Take a photo of your timetable and your whole week is set up. Student Trove keeps your classes, assignments, tests and marks in one planner, so you always know what's next and what you need to pass.

Built for university and high school students. Switch between Semester/Course and Term/Subject wording and the whole app follows.

Your timetable in seconds
Snap a photo, upload a PDF or paste text, and Smart Import turns it into your class schedule. Check every class before it's saved. New here? Scan your timetable first and Student Trove creates your subjects and term for you. Your first import is free.

A timetable that fits real schedules
Colour-coded weekly view with rooms, lecturers and Week A/Week B rotations. Classes outside term are hidden, and the calendar knows when you're on holiday.

Never miss a deadline
Track assignments, homework, tests, exams and projects in one calendar. Set several reminders per task, like a day before and three hours before. Repeat tasks weekly, and when one task moves, tasks that depend on it move too.

Tasks on your home screen
The Student Trove widget shows your next pending tasks, overdue first. Tap to jump straight to your calendar.

Know the mark you need
Log marks with weighted categories and see your average for each subject, term and year. The grade goal calculator tells you exactly what you need on your next test or exam to hit your target. Subject and term weights (credits for university) give you a true weighted average.

Stay on top of attendance
Mark classes present, absent or excused straight from Today. Set the absences allowed per subject and get a warning before you reach the limit.

Synced across your devices
Create a free account and your phone, tablet and the Student Trove web app stay in sync automatically. No manual backups. Prefer to stay offline? Everything works without an account and is stored encrypted on your device.

Premium: plan smarter, not longer
• Advisor: your academic coach, with grade simulations, what-if scenarios and a semester autopilot
• Study Planner: turn your deadlines and free time into study sessions you can reschedule
• Advanced Insights: spot overloaded weeks, attendance risk and grade trends before they catch up with you
• Workload heatmap: see your heaviest days at a glance
• Calendar Sync: classes, tasks and study blocks in your phone's calendar app
• Unlimited Smart Import
Try every Premium feature free for 14 days. Cancel anytime.

Made for every student
19 colour themes, four colour vision modes, high contrast, reduced motion, readable text mode and text size from 0.5× to 2×.

Free and Premium
Timetable, calendar, tasks, reminders, marks, grade goal calculator, attendance, home screen widget and cross-device sync are free. Smart Import after your first import, Advisor, Study Planner, Advanced Insights, workload heatmap and Calendar Sync are part of Premium.

About Smart Import and your data
Smart Import sends the photo, PDF or text you choose to our import service, which uses third-party services (OCR.space for text recognition and Google Gemini to organise the results) to read it. Nothing is imported until you review it. Everything else stays on your device unless you turn on sync.

Questions or ideas? Visit studenttrove.co.za.

title: Studix: Study Planner & Focus
description:
Stop juggling multiple apps to manage your academic life. Meet Studix — the ultimate all-in-one productivity ecosystem built specifically for students.

Whether you are preparing for final exams, managing daily university assignments, or trying to beat procrastination, Studix brings everything you need into one seamless, minimalist workspace. Designed with a dark-mode Bento UI, it reduces cognitive load and keeps you focused on what truly matters: getting things done.

🚀 CORE FEATURES:

📊 Bento-Style Dashboard
Get a bird's-eye view of your entire day. Track your task workload, pending assignments, actual focus time vs. scheduled focus, and daily habits all in one beautiful, glanceable grid.

✅ Smart Daily Planner
Say goodbye to chaotic to-do lists. Schedule your tasks with specific start and end times, assign vibrant color tags, and seamlessly tick them off as you conquer your day.

⏱️ Focus Stream (Multiplayer Deep Work)
Studying alone can be boring. Create or join live Focus Rooms with your friends (Squad). Sync your study sessions, track live countdowns, and chat with participants in real-time. Prefer to study alone? Switch to Zen Clock for a distraction-free, minimalist solo focus timer.

📓 Notes Vault
Your personal digital notebook. Jot down quick sticky notes, capture brilliant ideas, and keep all your essential study materials organized securely in one place.

💧 Habit & Squad Tracker
Stay hydrated with the daily Water Log and grow your study network by adding friends via their 7-Digit Student ID. Hold each other accountable and boost your productivity together.

🌟 WHY STUDIX?
• All-in-One: Planner, Notes, and Focus Timer in a single app.
• Zero Distractions: A clean, aesthetic dark UI built for deep focus.
• Student-Centric: Built by a student, understanding exactly what you need to survive and thrive in your academic journey.

Transform the way you study, track your progress, and build better habits.

Download Studix today and master your study flow!

title: TimeTable : Study Planner App
description:
TimeTable: Study Planner App – Smart Weekly TimeTable & Schedule Manager

TimeTable is a powerful yet simple TimeTable app designed to help you organize classes, work routines, study sessions, and recurring activities in one place. Whether you are a student, teacher, professional, or anyone managing a weekly schedule, TimeTable helps you stay organized and on time—every day.

With smart notifications, reliable alarms, offline access, and a clean interface, TimeTable makes weekly planning effortless and stress-free.

Why Choose TimeTable?

TimeTable is built for people who rely on structured routines. Instead of juggling notes, reminders, or multiple apps, TimeTable lets you create, manage, and follow a complete weekly TimeTable with precision.

From academic schedules to personal routines, TimeTable adapts to your needs while staying simple, fast, and reliable.

Weekly TimeTable Management

Create and manage a complete weekly TimeTable with ease:
Plan your schedule from Monday to Sunday
Add multiple entries with start time and end time
Set recurring TimeTable entries across multiple days
Use color coding for quick visual recognition
Add notes and descriptions to every TimeTable entry
Instantly view today’s schedule on app launch
TimeTable gives you a clear overview of your week, helping you stay focused and organized.

Smart TimeTable Notifications

Never miss an important task with built-in TimeTable notifications:
Get reminders before an event starts
Customize notification timing for each TimeTable entry
Notifications work even when the app is closed
Perfect for classes, meetings, study sessions, or routines
With TimeTable reminders, you’re always prepared and on schedule.

Reliable TimeTable Alarm System

TimeTable includes a dependable alarm system for time-critical tasks:
Exact-time alarms for every TimeTable entry
Alarms work when the phone is locked or idle
Simple stop-alarm button when the alarm rings
Built using Android’s native alarm system for accuracy
Whether it’s a class, meeting, or routine, TimeTable ensures you never miss the moment.

Clean, Modern & User-Friendly Design

TimeTable focuses on simplicity and clarity:
Modern Material Design 3 interface
Dark mode support for comfortable viewing
Smooth animations and subtle haptic feedback
Minimal, distraction-free layout
Automatically opens today’s TimeTable
Everything is designed to help you focus on your schedule—not the app.

Offline TimeTable – No Internet Required

Your schedule stays with you at all times:
All TimeTable data is stored locally on your device
Works completely offline
No account, no internet dependency
Your TimeTable is always accessible
Perfect for classrooms, travel, or low-connectivity environments.

Easy to Use & Flexible

TimeTable is designed for quick and effortless planning:
One-tap quick add button
Tap to edit or delete any TimeTable entry
Day-based tabs for fast navigation
One-tap alarm and reminder control
No learning curve—just open the app and start planning.

Who Is TimeTable For?

TimeTable is ideal for:
School and college students
Teachers, tutors, and educators
Coaching and tuition schedules
Professionals managing recurring routines
Anyone who needs a reliable weekly TimeTable
If your life runs on a schedule, TimeTable is built for you.

Why TimeTable Works Better

Simple yet powerful TimeTable management
Reliable alarms and reminders
Works offline with local storage
Clean, modern, and distraction-free design
Built for daily use and long-term planning

TimeTable is more than just a planner, it’s a reliable way to organize your time, stay consistent, and build better routines. Whether you are managing classes, work schedules, study sessions, or daily activities, TimeTable helps you stay focused and on track with minimal effort.

If you’re looking for an easy and effective way to manage your weekly schedule, TimeTable is the perfect solution.
